integrity: Analytic proof with exact finite computational corroboration; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge three-edge parallel paths only, with at least three paths; the canonical zero-sum Euclidean metric is essential. The full incenter set is described by affine dimension, not by all its boundary faces. Equivalent max-variance theorems may exist under other terminology.
title: Euclidean facet shells and incenter parity for three-edge generalized theta spaces \(\Theta_{3,m}\)
